response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.arcref, p.fundflux, AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g WHERE rate IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.arcref, g.fundflux, g.rate, g.rate - b.bench AS excess FROM g CROSS JOIN b WHERE g.rate > b.bench ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A scan with spanmin = 0 has a missing ratio, so it is treated as NULL via NULLIF and ignored. Scans with NULL gbsize or spanmin are also ignored.
Groups with no valid ratio have a NULL rate. They are excluded from the benchmark average and cannot exceed it.
Ties in excess are broken arbitrarily.
